title: Not the best Oxo product I've ever used
text:
Not the best Oxo product I've ever used. Surprisingly average for Oxo. Something about the contour just doesn't feel right. Bristles too stiff, almost like an old-fashioned broom, so it doesn't wipe away grease as well as I expected.
I always soak my dishes, so I rarely have baked on residue, which I suspect it may be a better use

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Soap Dispensing Palm Brush Refills - 2pack
features: Durable nylon bristles easily cleans baked-on food and are safe for non-stick cookware
Simply twist off brush to replace bristles
For use with Soap Dispensing Palm Brush and Soap Dispensing Mesh Scrub
Refills come in a pack of two and include replacement instructions
description: No more pumping a hard button and waiting for soap to drip slowly from a brush. Squirt soap on demand with the OXO Good Grips Soap Dispensing Palm Brush! With a light push of the soft, non-slip button, soap shoots out of the Brush and onto the item being scrubbed. Soap continues to squirt when the button is pressed, even when the reservoir is near empty. To fill, simply unscrew the cap and add soap to the reservoir. Then replace the cap for a tight seal. The Brush also features a soft, non-slip gripping surface and is contoured for optimal comfort and scrubbing power. The Brush head uses durable nylon bristles that easily clear away dirt and are safe for non-stick cookware. The storage set pairs the Good Grips Soap Dispensing Palm Brush with a handy holder that keeps it ready to go for the next dirty dish. The holder features a removable drip tray and built-in pour spout to keep countertops clean and dry. A non-skid base keeps the holder securely in place. When it's time to replace the Brush on your Soap Dispensing Palm Brush, simply twist the Brush head off. Refill Brush heads come in a pack of two for added convenience. Refill Brush, Sponge and Scrub heads come in a pack of two for convenience and include replacement instructions. Replacement sponge, scrub or brush heads sold separately.Dimensions: 12″ x 5″ x 5″.

details.Warranty Description: Oxo satisfaction guarantee, if for any reason you are not satisfied with an oxo product, return it for replacement or refund.
